skill.displayName: If you vanished today (quiet home → feed moves on)

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed WeryAI video-generation helper for a specific melancholic short-video format, with no hidden persistence or unrelated local data access found.

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses WERYAI_API_KEY, paid/network-required use, fixed API hosts, and HTTPS image URL inputs; the script reads only that environment variable and sends requests to fixed WeryAI endpoints.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, package installation, postinstall hook, or dependency-fetching mechanism was found; it relies on Node.js 18+ and the packaged script.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation language includes broad mood phrases and defaults to English on-screen text, so users should invoke it intentionally for the specific short-video format and override language if needed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No file writes, background workers, scheduled tasks, memory changes, privilege escalation, tool wrapping, or persistent behavior were found in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to generate vertical absence-themed videos, and the included CLI submits text, image, or multi-image video jobs to WeryAI; that capability is broader than the narrow template but still directly supports the advertised video-generation workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending prompts, public HTTPS image URLs, and your WeryAI API key to WeryAI for paid video generation. Use it deliberately for the absence-short template, avoid private image URLs, and specify subtitle language if English is not desired.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The script is a general WeryAI video CLI, but its networked text/image/multi-image generation is disclosed in the skill and reference docs and is coherent with the video-generation purpose.
[AE1] unexpected: The advisory scanner reported partial inspection, but the packaged scripts/video_gen.js was locally available and fully inspected during this adjudication.
[LP3] expected: Use of WERYAI_API_KEY and WeryAI network hosts is explicitly documented; no additional secret sources or undisclosed hosts were found.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The trigger wording is somewhat broad for mood-based requests, but this is a scoping/quality issue rather than evidence of hidden or harmful behavior.
[SQP-3] unexpected: English subtitle defaults and Chinese-only header comments in the CLI are language-choice concerns, not security concerns; the skill also notes user language can override in at least one place.
